scientific_integrity: The limiting distribution is proved via stationary generator identities, synchronization, and compact moment recursion; finite computations are supplementary. No independent external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Stationary interior-ratio weak limit; no quantitative mixing rates or extreme-ratio limit. The transient all-positive-first-part/all-negative-second-part count corner has zero stationary mass. Priority only checked against accessible literature; a plausible 2013 general-framework source was available only at abstract level.
title: A skew-beta stationary law for two opposed zealots on complete bipartite voter networks
